all our customers. ® Since you deliver packages by bike in
the city every day, we want your feedback on a new cargo
bike. ®it has a storage unit attached that will allow you
to carry many more packages than usual. We're currently
borrowing a few from the manufacturer to test out before
we purchase them. So today you'll be using them on your
regular routes. ® Just a reminder: please lock up the bikes
